maria: quick check — since yesterday's deploy i'm not seeing spans for the async-batcher worker in jaeger. request traces show the ingress and router spans but the worker -> db spans are missing. any quick things to check? /cc @sam @jay
jay: did we change sampler config in the release? also check worker logs for exporter errors or messages about 'span dropped'
alex: dashboard links: Grafana traces panel: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/abcd/traces-panel and Jaeger query: https://jaeger.redwood.net/trace?service=async-batcher. for logs use Kibana: https://logs.redwood.net/app/kibana#/discover/ (filter service:async-batcher)
infra-bot: deploy completed: async-batcher v3.12.0 -> prod at 2026-03-17T22:11Z by @deploy-ci :rocket:
sam: quick checklist to rule out sampling vs propagation:
- check OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG env on the pod
- grep worker logs for "export failed" / "NoOpSpan" / "sampler"
- ensure background job wrapper is preserving context (contextvars / attach span)
- run: curl -s 'http://jaeger-query/api/traces?service=async-batcher&limit=5' | jq '
maria: prod env on one worker: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.05
jay: parentbased_traceidratio looks weird — we standardize on ParentBased(TraceIdRatioBased(x)) or "parentbased" with traceidratio arg. parentbased_traceidratio might not be recognized by SDK and could fallback to AlwaysOff
maria: here's the tracer init from the worker:
```python
TracerProvider(
  sampler=ParentBasedTraceIdRatio(float(os.getenv("OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG", "0"))),
  resource=Resource.create(...),
)
```
alex: uh — there is no ParentBasedTraceIdRatio class in upstream OTel python. correct pattern is: ParentBased(TraceIdRatioBased(0.05)). if our helper was removed in v1.13 the import would fail or the constructor would be unknown and the SDK might default to an AlwaysOff/Noop sampler. that explains NoOpSpan in logs
sam: run this on a pod to confirm: kubectl -n prod exec -it deploy/async-batcher --container worker -- sh -c 'env | rg OTEL|python -c "import pkgutil, opentelemetry; print(opentelemetry.__version__)"' and grep logs: kubectl logs deploy/async-batcher -c worker | rg "NoOpSpan|Telemetry exporter failed|sampler"
maria: log snippet I found: 
"ERROR Telemetry exporter failed to initialize: unknown sampler 'ParentBasedTraceIdRatio'"
"DEBUG NoOpSpan started for task.process_batch"
jay: nailed it. config string didn't match SDK API after the instrumentation bump. two options: immediate hotfix via helm values to a supported sampler, and follow up code change to parse our legacy envs into proper SDK sampler objects
alex: search shows the pattern in repo: rg "ParentBasedTraceIdRatio" -> services: async-batcher, prefetcher, file-writer. owners: @maria, @lee, @sam. tagging them to coordinate
sam: mitigation proposal: set OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.01 in helm for async-batcher so sampler resolves to ParentBased(TraceIdRatioBased(0.01)). less ingest but brings spans back. alternative: always_on for short window to verify edges but higher cost
jay: agree. also add a quick unit test that the helper config maps to an actual SDK sampler type so future bumps fail fast in CI
maria: i'll patch helm values to 0.01 and redeploy now. opening a PR for the code helper to accept both legacy and new formats
infra-bot: rollout started: async-batcher v3.12.1 (sampler env patch) by @maria — CI: https://ci.redwood.net/builds/2345
maria: confirmed — seeing spans again in jaeger for recently processed batches, parent/child links restored. will follow up with PR and a small postmortem note. thanks all :thumbsup:
